description: bits-ui's ToggleGroup of type multiple compiled from its published source (one record for the options types of its class hierarchy, the discriminant type narrowing the props) through shadcn-svelte's unmodified toggle-group wrappers (svelte's setContext/getContext with a getter object, bind:value={value as never}, the --gap custom property) and the toggle-group-demo and toggle-group-vertical demos, and a group bound to the app's string array with a disabled item. Pressed by clicks, by Space and Enter on the focused item; arrow keys move focus through bits-ui's roving focus group (looping, skipping the disabled item, ArrowDown in the vertical group), Home and End; set from outside through the bound value; onValueChange counts the group's own changes. aria-pressed, data-state, tabindex (roving), the pressed backgrounds and focus rings (pixel regions)

knownGaps.pixels: At 420px the bound row (four 14px toggle labels and the centred label of the reset button in a 388x36 region) differs by 3.8-3.9/255: with identical boxes and glyph positions, glyph coverage differs (vello against Skia and FreeType; docs/BLITZ-GAPS.md, glyph rasterisation)
